title: A short burst of independent steps is the CDC line at about 15 months
summary: Most children take a few steps on their own by about 15 months, the US CDC says.
body: The CDC 15-month page prints takes a few steps on his own. The burst is short. No adult hand is in the wording. The page files it with what most children do by 15 months. A longer stretch across a room is not this line. Waiting past that age is not a verdict from this sentence. Lists published outside the United States can pick another month.

sources.title: Milestones by 15 Months
sources.author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.note: Movement line: Takes a few steps on his own.
